title: unwrapping two different Results unions both error types into the enclosing function's failure row
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Propagation': 'The compiler MUST include the unwrapped Result's error type in the enclosing function's inferred E.' specification/type-system.mdx, 'Fallibility Inference', requires E to be inferred from Result propagation. The three output lines exercise the success path and BOTH members of the union, so an implementation that kept only one arm of the row would fail on one of them.
